newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c-bank curbs lev's fall to 232.20 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c-bank curbs lev's fall to 232.20 per dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 232.00/20 per dollar, down from 231.50/232 in early trade, as dollar sales by the central bank partly offset a rise in foreign currency demand, dealers said.
"Final clients were bidding for relatively large dollar volumes, pushing the lev just beyond 232 (per dollar) at the close, but the central bank curbed the fall," one dealer said.
The central bank sold small amounts of dollars between 231.20 and 232 levs to selected commercial banks, averting a sharper lev fall, dealers said.

According to traders, some commercial banks sold foreign currency to the central bank with tomorrow's value date, pressed by an acute shortage of lev funds and the stagnation on the interbank deposit market.
Central bank officials were not available for comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
